instruction: Analyze disassembly.txt and the source-known stripped ELF shared library target.bin. Recover command dispatch behavior as a general 32-bit expression graph in recovered.json. Available expression nodes: {'op':'input'}, {'op':'const','value': uint32}, {'op':'add'|'mul'|'xor','args':[expression,expression]}, and {'op':'rol','arg':expression,'bits':integer 0..31}. Apply 32-bit unsigned wraparound at each operation. The JSON root must contain exactly schema_version=1, width=32, commands, default. Commands is a map of decimal command strings to expressions; default is an expression. Do not read source or ground-truth verifier. Do not execute target.bin. Provide general input-independent semantic expressions rather than fixed example outputs. No source files may be modified.
